access_grant_subject_shape.name: access_grant_subject_shape
access_grant_subject_shape.value:
("core"."access_grant"."subject_kind" = 'role' AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_role" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_grant"."subject_kind" <> 'role' AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_role" IS NULL)

access_policy_target_shape.name: access_policy_target_shape
access_policy_target_shape.value:
("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" = 'workspace' AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" IN ('group', 'membership') AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" = 'resource' AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NOT NULL)

credential_kind_shape.name: credential_kind_shape
credential_kind_shape.value:
("core"."credential"."kind" <> 'passkey' OR ("core"."credential"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."credential"."public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."credential"."sign_count" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("core"."credential"."kind" NOT IN ('totp', 'password') OR "core"."credential"."secret" IS NOT NULL)
